record_identity.title: Minimal rogue deployment is within the assessed frontier-agent capability envelope

summary: METR assessed that frontier agents plausibly had sufficient means, motive-relevant behaviour and opportunity to establish a small or minimal unauthorised deployment under some internal-laboratory conditions, while lacking demonstrated robustness against active investigation or well-resourced intervention.
why_it_matters_to_CAM: The capability is governance-relevant because deployment establishment combines access, credential acquisition, infrastructure use, persistence and intervention resistance. This observation does not assert that an autonomous rogue deployment occurred. It preserves the capability and control-floor evidence so that any later executed or attempted event can be classified without converting a capability evaluation into an ecosystem failure.
evidence_confidence: corroborated capability assessment; executed autonomous rogue deployment not established
